from w3lib.url import url_query_cleaner, url_query_parameter

url = "http://ex.com/path?a=1&b=2&a=3&empty=&c=4#frag"
kept = url_query_cleaner(url, ["a", "empty"], unique=False, keep_fragments=True)
removed = url_query_cleaner(url, ["b", "c"], remove=True, keep_fragments=False)
values = [
    url_query_parameter(kept, "a"),
    url_query_parameter(kept, "empty"),
    url_query_parameter(kept, "empty", keep_blank_values=1),
]

print(kept)
print(removed)
print(values)
